ModMetaData.name: A Sloth Mod Renew - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for A Sloth Mod Renew, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Every scenario reads the def database at the main menu - no save is loaded, and none is needed: this mod ships two Defs and four guarded XML patches, nothing that only shows up in a running colony. What still needs a human (whether the sloth actually spawns in a rainforest, whether a trader actually stocks it) stays in ../../../TESTING.md, unverified until played; see that file's "Pickle scope" note.
